title: Clinical Trial Literature Synthesis for Biotech R&D
business: Biotechnology research teams developing novel therapeutic compounds.
problem: Researchers struggle to manually filter high volumes of conflicting clinical trial data, leading to delayed decision-making and potential oversight of critical negative citation contexts.
solution: By integrating the Scite plugin with ChatGPT, researchers can automate the retrieval of scientific papers and specifically inspect citation contexts to determine if subsequent studies support or contrast with initial findings, effectively filtering out noise.
steps: Connect the Scite plugin to the ChatGPT interface to enable external research capabilities.
Input specific therapeutic research queries into the chat interface to trigger Scite searches.
Review the returned citation graphs and context snippets to identify consensus or controversy in the literature.
Save relevant papers and their specific citation decisions into a structured Scite Collection for team review.
Generate a formatted bibliography directly from the curated Collection to support internal R&D documentation.
outcome: Accelerated literature review cycles and improved confidence in evidence-based decision-making through verified citation contexts.
limitation: The plugin relies on the availability of indexed full-text or abstract data; users must verify the depth of coverage for niche or very recent pre-print publications by checking the source metadata.
